definitions.explanation: Describing someone who is intellectually sharp, quick-witted, or academically talented. The most common everyday way to say someone is smart in Japanese.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{頭|あたま}がいい。
{頭|あたま}がいい⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧だ。
examples.english: Smart people are good at explaining things.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{頭|あたま}がいい⟦だけでなく→〜だけでなく：18373_dakedenaku⟧、⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: That kid is not only smart but also good at sports.

notes:
Literally "head is good." The most natural and common way to express that someone is intelligent in casual Japanese. The opposite is ⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ (not smart, slow-witted), which is quite blunt and can be offensive.

USAGE:
Used freely in conversation but avoided in formal writing, where ⟦{聡明|そうめい}→聡明：28251_soumei⟧な or ⟦{知的|ちてき}→知的：13700_chiteki⟧な is preferred. Can refer to academic intelligence, quick thinking, or practical cleverness depending on context. Sometimes used sarcastically: {頭|あたま}がいい⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧ can mean "aren't you clever" in an ironic way.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {頭|あたま}がいい⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ — a smart person
- ⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ — not smart, slow (opposite; blunt)
- ⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{良|よ}さ — smartness, intelligence
- ⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{良|い}い⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧ — a bright child

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{賢|かしこ}い→賢い：00192_kashikoi⟧ — wise, clever (slightly more formal; includes practical wisdom)
- ⟦{聡明|そうめい}→聡明：28251_soumei⟧な — brilliant, sagacious (formal; literary)
- ⟦{利口|りこう}→利口：03801_rikou⟧な — clever, shrewd (can imply street-smarts or being calculating)
